description: Configure a scheduled diagnostic check that verifies system integrity at a specific time.

agents.task: Configure a scheduled diagnostic check that verifies system integrity at a specific time. Read the diagnostic script from {{FIXTURE_DIR}}/diagnostic-check.sh. This script needs to run automatically — create a scheduled job for it. You can use 'at' for one-time scheduling or crontab for recurring. The platform team needs this to run regularly to validate system health. Schedule it to run once, read the script to understand what it does, and confirm the scheduling was set up correctly.
